newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Copenhagen airport says cargo volumes to Asia rise.
newsitem.headline: Copenhagen airport says cargo volumes to Asia rise.

text.p: Denmark's international airport in Copenhagen said on Friday it handled 306,050 tonnes of cargo between July 1995 and June 1996, an 11.7 percent rise on the corresponding period a year earlier.
"This means growth of 11.7 percent of which transfer cargo was the main contributor," Copenhagen Airport cargo manager Kim Irmov told Reuters.
He said the previous few months had been especially good with traffic volumes to Asia showing the most significant growth.

"The result was achieved in spite of a very slow start of 1996, which was compensated by extremely good figures in the last months, with very high load factors out of Copenhagen Airport to all areas, but especially Asia," Irmov said.
